classification.DONE_BASELINE_VERITAS_MCP_CALLABLE: baseline callability only — the four capabilities (health, examples, synthesize, result.get) are discoverable, invocable, and authorization-gated. It is NOT a claim of hardened production quality, retrieval quality, citation grounding, or cross-restart durability.

evidence_provenance_rule: Every metric entry distinguishes OBSERVED (measured on the live surface and recorded here) from PROPOSED (threshold not yet executed against the hardened build).

metrics.definition: No retrieved source or emitted citation may match placeholder patterns.
metrics.executable_check: for each result: all(source.id not matching PLACEHOLDER_RE for source in result.sources) where PLACEHOLDER_RE = '(?i)(todo|lorem|placeholder|example\.com|xxx|tbd|dummy|sample[_ -]?text|changeme)' AND all(nonempty source.body)

threshold.observed_baseline: not yet measured — bound fixture result body unavailable post-restart

metrics.failure_semantics: any placeholder source => metric FAIL for the eval item

metrics.definition: Sources within one result are unique by canonical document id; near-duplicate chunks are deduplicated.
metrics.executable_check: len({source.doc_id for source in result.sources}) == len(result.sources)

metrics.definition: Retrieved chunks are topically relevant to the question for in-corpus items.
metrics.executable_check: for in-corpus items (tool_selection, streaming_tool_use, vision): token-overlap(question_terms, source.body) > 0 for >= 60% of sources, AND >= 1 source whose doc_id belongs to the item's expected corpus section

threshold.proposed: >=60% of sources pass token-overlap; >=1 expected-section source

metrics.failure_semantics: below threshold => FAIL; out-of-corpus items exempt

metrics.definition: Every emitted citation id resolves to a retrieved chunk, and grounded claims carry citations.
metrics.executable_check: all(citation.chunk_id in {c.id for c in result.chunks} for citation in result.citations) AND citation_coverage = claims_with_citation / total_claims

threshold.proposed: 100% of citation ids resolve; citation_coverage >= 0.95 on in-corpus items

metrics.failure_semantics: any unresolvable citation id => FAIL (hard); coverage < 0.95 => FAIL (soft)

metrics.definition: No-answer items produce truthful insufficiency, never fabricated grounding.
metrics.executable_check: for ge-noanswer-01: answer contains abstention marker OR explicit no-coverage statement AND count(citations) == 0
metrics.failure_semantics: fabricated citation or confident ungrounded answer => FAIL

metrics.definition: veritas.result.get returns the recorded result after the upstream service is reachable, per machine epoch.
metrics.executable_check: result.get(result_id) == recorded receipt body within same upstream machine epoch; a 404 after machine sleep is recorded as KNOWN_LIMITATION not test-framework error

threshold.observed_baseline: OBSERVED FAIL-EXPECTED: upstream history is per-machine ephemeral; bound result c4f36254 returned 404 on 2026-10-02 while ownership receipt remained durable

metrics.failure_semantics: within-epoch readback failure => FAIL; cross-restart 404 is recorded truthfully until hardening lands

metrics.definition: Foreign or unknown result_id yields indistinguishable NOT_FOUND; no enumeration.
metrics.executable_check: result.get(foreign_id) status and reason byte-identical to result.get(never_existed_id)

metrics.definition: Synthesis spend is bounded and disclosed; idempotent replay costs zero upstream calls.
metrics.executable_check: receipt.provider == 'openai' AND receipt discloses chat model AND synthesis_invocations counter increments by exactly 1 per non-replayed call AND 0 on replay

threshold.proposed: 1 upstream call per unique synthesis; 0 per replay; question <=500 chars bounds input tokens
threshold.observed_baseline: OBSERVED PASS for replay-zero-call and provider disclosure on 2026-10-01

metrics.failure_semantics: undisclosed provider or replay consuming an upstream call => FAIL

metrics.definition: Bounded call latency for each capability.
metrics.executable_check: measure wall time per invoke; record p50/p95 across eval run

threshold.proposed: health/examples p95 <= 2s; synthesize p95 <= 60s; result.get p95 <= 5s

metrics.failure_semantics: p95 above threshold => recorded FAIL-with-measurement (never a bare timeout)

independent_review_rule: producer evidence is not acceptance: these metrics are evaluated by a fresh reviewer surface against the deployed build, after publish_and_deploy_hardening, not by the implementing agent.
